channel.title: Car and Driver - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Car and Driver (caranddriver.com)

item.title: Ford Recalls Nearly 413,000 Older Explorers for Faulty Rear Suspension
item.description: The recall involves 2017–2019 Explorers with defective rear toe links that could break and cause an accident.

item.title: If You Want This Fresh-Faced Nissan Versa, You've Got to Go to Mexico
item.description: While Nissan killed off its most affordable model in the U.S. after 2025, the Versa gains sharper styling as it enters a new generation in Mexico.

item.title: Nissan to Sell Unibody Pathfinder Alongside Body-on-Frame Version
item.description: The automaker is planning to sell the current unibody Pathfinder alongside a body-on-frame model by the same name.

item.title: 2027 Chrysler Pacifica's Fresh Face Revealed in New Teaser Photos
item.description: Chrysler is updating its popular minivan, with a sharp new front-end design that features vertically oriented headlights and a new logo.

item.title: 2024 Chevrolet Trax Long-Term Wrap: Consistency Is a Virtue
item.description: After 40,000 miles, our 2024 Chevrolet Trax departs with a reputation as a loyal and low-maintenance—if unexciting—companion.

item.title: View Photos of the Oshkosh Striker 3000
item.description: See the Oshkosh Striker 3000 from every angle.

item.title: Firetruck Extraordinaire: We Try Out the Oshkosh Striker 3000
item.description: Putting out fires is fine. Poking holes in airplanes and blowing windows out of mobile homes—now that's superb.

item.title: 2027 Volvo EX30 Can Be a Mobile Charger with Over-the-Air Update
item.description: The electric subcompact SUV also offers a fresh user interface, and a new entry-level powertrain has less power for a lower price.
